dn-eftl.name: E-FTL tube and profile laser cutters, Ø0.3″ – 13.8″, 3 – 20 kW

vn-ult.name: ULT tube and pipe lasers, two or three chucks, Ø0.4 – 14.2″, 20 – 40 ft tubes, 1.5 – 40 kW
vn-ult.summary: The tube laser for round, square, rectangular, oval and open profiles: pneumatic self-centring chucks at both ends of the bar, servo-following supports under it, and a 1.5 to 40 kW source that cuts holes, slots, copes and notches and parts the tube in one pass. Four chuck sizes — Ø6.3″, 9.4″, 11″ and 14.2″ — for bars of 20, 30 or 40 ft and up to 2,205 lb; 328 ft/min and 1.2 G on the small chucks. The three-chuck version takes over the bar as it shortens, so the last part is cut with no remnant. Pneumatic loaders, bundle feeding, a ±45° five-axis bevel head and TubesT nesting are options.

sf-t.name: T series two-chuck tube lasers, Ø0.5 – 14″, 20 – 40 ft, 1.5 – 6 kW
sf-t.summary: The tube laser most shops start with, and the simplest of the Senfeng range: two pneumatic self-centring chucks hold the tube at both ends, servo following supports carry it, and a 1.5 to 6 kW source cuts round, square, rectangular and open profiles from Ø0.5″ to 14″. Fifteen models: chucks for Ø4.7, 6.6, 9 and 14″ on 20, 30 and 40 ft beds, and 23 and 24.6 ft (7 / 7.5 m) beds for long stock. The tube is loaded by hand or crane as standard; a semi-automatic or fully automatic loader can be added. Two chucks leave a short tail on every bar — the NT cuts with zero tail, the PLUS is faster on small tube and the GT cuts bevels.
